page.overview:
Who is Carver Security Guard (Hamburg) 7?

This Carver Security Guard was a fictional unnamed henchman who appeared briefly in the 1997 James Bond film Tomorrow Never Dies. The stuntman who portrayed him remains unknown.

During the parking garage car chase at Hotel Atlantic, this henchman prepares to fire a rocket from his LAW-80 at Bond's BMW 750iL in order to kill Bond. However, the rocket flies through the destroyed windscreen and rear-window, and hits the black Ford Scorpio chasing the BMW, killing both henchmen inside.
